name: Ian Chesterton
oracle_text:
Science Teacher — Each Saga spell you cast has replicate. The replicate cost is equal to its mana cost. (When you cast that Saga, copy it for each time you paid its replicate cost. Copies of Saga spells become tokens.)
Doctor's companion (You can have two commanders if the other is the Doctor.)
blocked_sentences: Science Teacher — Each Saga spell you cast has replicate. The replicate cost is equal to its mana cost

needs.what: a static that grants replicate to spells you cast matching a spell filter (subtypes: ["Saga"]), with the replicate cost equal to that spell's own mana cost: an additional cost payable any number of times on cast, and on cast a trigger copies the spell once per payment, with copies of permanent spells (Sagas) resolving into tokens
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No replicate exists anywhere in the reference: card_level_cost_keys has additional_repeatable and multikicker, but those are a card's own printed costs and cannot be granted to other spells; no static effect grants an additional or repeatable cost to spells (grant_warp, grant_miracle, granted_alternative_cost and cast_gains_keywords cover other mechanics); copy_spell copies a spell but nothing ties it to a count of cost payments, and nothing makes a copied permanent spell become a token
